newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 19.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Wednesday:
WASHINGTON - Bethesda's Marriott International chain agreed to take the keys to the 150-hotel Renaissance Group in a $1 billion acquisition.
WASHINGTON - The chief executive of Silicon Graphics Inc said his company erred when it sold four supercomputers to a Russian nuclear weapons facility in possible violation of federal export rules.
NEW YORK - Stocks vaulted into record territory as a burst of late buying reversed a quiet session on Wall Street.
LOS ANGELES - The Communications Workers of America and the United Food and Commercial Workers are discussing a merger that would create one of the nation's largest unions.
WASHINGTON - Biotechnology firms find a growth market in animal health care, an industry that is only beginning to apply genetic science to the discovery of new drugs.
